QuestInfo.name: Building a New House For Blackbull
QuestInfo.0: I hear that #p501# in #m10004000# is building a new house...
QuestInfo.1: I ran into #p501# again, the guy whose house I'd helped fix before. He was surprised at how strong I'd gotten and asked me for another favor, a bit harder than the last one. His cousins from #m10001000# are trying to move to #m10004000#, so he needs to build a new house for them! The materials he needs for this project are #b100 #t4000043#s#k, #b30 #t4003000#s#k, #b30 #t4003001##k, and #b#t4001006##k. His son had the deed when it was stolen by #o31#s near #m10005000#... Hmmm... I should look for ones wandering around in the Deep Forest...
QuestInfo.2: I got #p501# the items he requested, so that all of his cousins could move to #m10004000#. It was really tough, and I hope he doesn't ask me to BUILD a house for him next time...

0.0: Hey, it's you! Got pretty famous since the last time I saw you, huh? Well, thanks to you, I got my house fixed just fine. But hmm... There's a problem... All my relatives from #m10001000# want to move to this town. I need to build a new house for them, but I don't even have the materials to build with...
0.1: Well hey! Sorry to ask you for another favor, but can you get the stuff necessary to build a house for my cousins? So many relatives are coming in that things like a #t4000005# or #t4000011#s from last time won't do. Do you think you could help? I'll tell you what to get instead.
0.2: I'll need #b100 #t4000043#s#k, #b30 #t4003000#s#k, and #b30 pieces of #t4003001##k. But with only these... Well, a couple of days ago, a document titled #b#t4001006##k that I purchased disappeared... My son said he was attacked by monsters while carrying the deed.
0.3: Reptiles called #r#o31##k that live in the forest took the deed to the land. Can you help me get the deed and the necessary materials to build the house? If so, then you'll be handsomely rewarded for your work... Good luck!

1.0: THIS is the deed to the land that my son lost! And you brought all the necessary materials to build the house! Thank you so much... my relatives can all move in and live in #m10004000#! As a sign of appreciation...
1.1: Okay, now choose the scroll of your liking... Their success rates are all 10%.

yes.0: Hopefully the scroll I gave you helps. Here's a little bit of money too. I'll never forget the fact that you helped me. For that, I'll spread the news of your good deed all over the town. What do you think? Anyway, thank you so much for helping me out. We'll probably meet again...

item.0: Looks like you haven't gotten all the necessary materials. Please get #b100 #t4000043#s#k, #b30 #t4003000#s#k, #b30 pieces of #t4003001##k, and the lost #b#t4001006##k. Please hurry, before they eat the deed...
